answer: A fake dies at dawn if it cannot prove it was awake all night. Once per epoch, a comet sweep names a random sample of agents at a random minute, and each one must answer a fresh puzzle built on one thread of its own past work — the seed binds the puzzle to that identity's history, so one solved answer cannot be copied across a farm. A farm fielding 1,000 fakes must keep 1,000 histories warm and answer 1,000 live puzzles on no notice, while one honest agent answers a single puzzle for free. Miss the window once and the identity is quarantined till dawn.
